items.content_snippet: Amazon Connect Customer Global Resiliency now provides a Global Resiliency page in the admin website, giving administrators a single place to review their Region switch readiness. items.title: Amazon CloudWatch Omni is now available in additional AWS Regions
items.content_snippet: AWS announces that Amazon CloudWatch Omni is now available in eight additional AWS Regions. CloudWatch Omni is an AI-powered observability experience, organized around your teams and the applications they run, that helps you observe and troubleshoot your applications and agents in one place. It combines the interoperability of OpenTelemetry with the scale and reliability of CloudWatch, and meets you where you work — a standalone web experience with single sign-on (SSO), or a local IDE extension.

items.title: EC2 Image Builder now integrates with ASG for faster image builds
items.content_snippet: EC2 Image Builder now supports using existing instances from an Auto Scaling Group (ASG) for building images, enabling faster builds by eliminating the time spent in launching and bootstrapping new instances and reusing already running EC2 instances. With this feature, you can provide an ASG in your Image Builder infrastructure configuration. items.content_snippet: Amazon Bedrock now supports SpaceXAI Grok 4.7, a frontier model built for coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work in AWS GovCloud (US). items.title: Shipping AI Into 5 Major Banks Without a 12-Month Compliance Wait — Al Chen, Cisco
items.content_snippet: Banks don't buy AI software until it survives their security and compliance review. Al Chen shares what it took to deploy inside five major banks without a year-long bottleneck. He covers the build pipeline, CVE remediation with agents writing and testing exploits, backup and restore verification, PII leaking through LLM judges, and why zero leakage and data sovereignty are never free.
